fields.Name: T035 - Products Configure-View Panel
fields.Description: Opens the Products entity grid once, then walks its Configure View panel sections (Columns management, per-column Format editor, Smart Filter mode, Add Aggregate dialog, aggregate summary), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T066, T067, T077, T079, T080.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Products' entity grid — navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Products (or type 'Products' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the exact match). Wait for the grid to load. Then open Configure View (the sliders / 'Configure view settings' icon in the grid toolbar) and walk these sections IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each one set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) products-grid — the Products grid finishes loading with rows or a valid empty state; (2) columns-management — on the Configure View 'Columns' tab, the column-management UI shows 'Visible Columns' and 'Hidden Columns' lists; (3) column-format-editor — still on the Columns tab, click a column's paintbrush 'Format column' button to open the format-editor sub-panel (Format Type dropdown, alignment/style controls, live Preview); (4) smart-filter — switch to the 'Filters' tab, choose 'Smart Filter', and confirm the natural-language description textarea plus example chips render; (5) add-aggregate-dialog — switch to the 'Aggregates' tab and click 'Add Aggregate' to open the aggregate setup dialog (function + field + display-type choices); (6) aggregate-summary — complete the aggregate (e.g. a count or sum on a column) and confirm an aggregate result/summary value is shown. Keep going until every section has been visited. You do NOT need to save any configuration. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait for content rather than navigating away.

checkpoints.name: products-grid
visualCriteria: The Products entity grid is loaded, showing data rows or a valid empty state

checkpoints.name: columns-management
checkpoints.instruction: Configure View > Columns tab shows column lists
visualCriteria: The Configure View 'Columns' tab renders the column-management UI with 'Visible Columns' and 'Hidden Columns' lists

checkpoints.name: column-format-editor
visualCriteria: Clicking a column's paintbrush button opens the format-editor sub-panel with a Format Type selector, alignment/style controls, and a live Preview section

checkpoints.name: smart-filter
visualCriteria: Selecting 'Smart Filter' on the Filters tab reveals a natural-language description textarea plus example prompt chips

checkpoints.name: add-aggregate-dialog
visualCriteria: Clicking 'Add Aggregate' opens an aggregate setup dialog offering an aggregate function, a field choice, and a display-type option

checkpoints.name: aggregate-summary
checkpoints.instruction: configure an aggregate and see its result
visualCriteria: An aggregate is configured and an aggregate result/summary value (a count/sum/average) is displayed, with no error
